subject: checking for more than just server.R's timestamp

messages.author: bff9e4feca8b059f
messages.subject: checking for more than just server.R's timestamp
parts:
I have a rapidly growing application that I've begun to split up into separate source .R files, loaded into server.R with source(..., local=T).  This seems the best way to manage burgeoning complexity.

Of course, now when I update those files, I have to also "touch" server.R to get the server to reload the sources.  I see the function in shiny.R that controls this behavior, and it seems it could easily be configured to look for other .R files (perhaps in a certain configurable directory) or any file specified by a matching glob string, and to take the most recent modified time over all these files, rather than just the mtime of server.R

Are there objections/concerns with such behavior?  I'm happy to supply the first iteration of a patch, but don't want to waste time if the "vision" is going elsewhere.

Thanks,
-Aaron
